title: Size the dossier-project load timeouts that syzygy-bpyt.4.13's comments added (gate-acts, screen, close, execution-flags, run-evidence) (PR 520 R1 N6)
description:
From the round-1 review of PR #520 (syzygy-bpyt.4.13), docs/reviews/R-GP-IMPL-PACKAGE-READER-TIMEOUTS-1-RAW.md N6 (retained at landing). The coordinator ruled PR #520 to package-reader.test.ts alone, but five coordinator comments on 4.13 (2026-10-22) widened it. Carriers exist for start-gates.test.ts (syzygy-y3uc), the act-families.test.ts 10 s hook (syzygy-bpyt.4.8) and git-object-reader.test.ts's 'reviewer's amplification shape' 30 s bound (syzygy-bpyt.4.5). [Observed by the reviewer, 806-bead sweep] No bead carries the rest, which this bead now owns, all in the @syzygy/polaris-dossier project: 5000 ms default timeouts at load about 70 (lane A, PR 516 head bddbbf6c) in gate-acts.test.ts (7), screen.test.ts (4), close.test.ts (3), execution-flags.test.ts (2) and run-evidence.test.ts (1); screen.test.ts's 10 s hook; and gate-acts.test.ts 'follow the tree in either state' over its explicit 60 s bound (60.2-64.7 s at load about 90, lane B on PR 514). Clean-clone batteries stay 110/0 and CI passes; these fail only under local load.

Do: apply PR #520's method per file. Measure with the committed scripts/measure_vitest_test_durations.py (without --profile, which PR #520 removed under its round-3 stopping rule; see syzygy-bpyt.4.27), size with scripts/size_vitest_test_timeouts.py (worst x3, rounded up to 5 s, for every test whose worst exceeds 2.5 s, stating the denominator), commit the records, and change no assertion. Where a test is slow because it spawns git, say so in a one-line comment and prefer lightening the fixture when that is simpler. Test-only; no CC-REV-1 class unless the review rules otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: each named file's sized tests carry an explicit timeout from a recorded measurement under load, by the stated rule, with the denominator per file. AC2: gate-acts 'follow the tree in either state' is re-sized or its fixture lightened, with the measurement recorded. AC3: --check of the sizing script passes for each file; assertions byte-identical outside the timeout argument; Tests: +a ~b -c reported.

dependencies.title: Greenfield parity M2: tests, build and CI - run from source, honest suite tiers, one test kit, one mutation runner
dependencies.description:
Outcome: the product builds without compiling tests, tooling runs from source without --force rebuilds, the unit suite is hermetic and fast with integration and end-to-end tiers beside it, test helpers live in one kit, and rule-6 mutation runs use one runner and one evidence schema.

Why (docs/plans/2026-10-21-greenfield-parity-audit.md findings TB-1..TB-6): 4,679 tests in 228 files took 3:40 wall; 65 files (spawning processes, git, servers or Chrome) take 68% of the time and run in the "unit" run; 233 of about 451 emitted dist/*.js files are tests; 15 of 22 root scripts prefix `npm run build:poc --silent` (tsc -b --force); `build` and `typecheck` are byte-identical; the package graph is encoded in five places (package.json, tsconfig references, imports, vitest.config.ts aliases, guard-test root lists); one guard's root list has already drifted (a bug); six mutation frameworks share one spec shape.
dependencies.design:
Audit-key: greenfield:tooling-sprawl:vitest.config.ts
Model tier: Opus-class lead; children carry their own tiers.
dependencies.acceptance_criteria:
1. Children closed.
2. Unit-tier wall time and test counts per tier reported.
3. Reconciliation bead closed.

dependencies.title: package-reader.test.ts: three tests hit vitest's 5000 ms default under load in a full run
dependencies.description: Reported by lane A in the syzygy-bpyt.8.1 Worker Report (PR #510). [Observed by the lane] In a full npx vitest run at load average about 25, three tests in packages/polaris-generation-consent/src/package-reader.test.ts (lines 353, 368 and 1042 at c55acb73) timed out at vitest's 5000 ms default. The file passes alone: Tests 299 passed (299). Fix: profile those three tests; give each an explicit timeout sized from a measured worst case under load, or lighten their fixtures. Do not raise the global default. Line numbers may shift once #505 (syzygy-bpyt.8.4) lands; re-locate by test name.
